offers_products.reason: Makes instruments, sensors, biological indicators and consumables for quality control and life science labs.

offers_services.reason: Offers calibration, testing and validation services alongside its products, though these are the smaller part.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are pharma, medical device makers, labs, hospitals and environmental agencies, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to pharma manufacturers, healthcare providers, device makers, labs and government environmental agencies.

recurring_revenue.reason: Consumables, sterilization indicators, sensors and calibration services are repurchased regularly by regulated customers.

cyclical_demand.reason: Regulated quality control and compliance testing in pharma and healthcare is hard to postpone.

big_ticket.reason: Mostly consumables, sensors and mid-priced instruments bought repeatedly, not large one-off purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes mainly from manufactured instruments and consumables, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are large pharma and biotech firms, medical device makers, hospitals and government agencies.

asset_heavy.reason: Specialty instrument and consumables manufacturing with modest plants; growth comes mainly from acquisitions and R&D.

notes: Product versus service split and recurring share are judged from general knowledge of the company.
